mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification.notification (id, event_id, recipient_user_id, email, kind, target_ref, locale, status, sent_at, failure_reason, created_at) SELECT #{id}, #{eventId}, #{recipientUserId}, #{email}, #{kind}, #{targetRef}, #{locale}, #{status}, #{sentAt}, #{failureReason}, #{createdAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification.notification WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId})
